name: Inner Sea Armature
summary: Inner Sea Armature is a Dwemer ruin west of Davon's Watch in Stonefalls containing outlaws and Dwarven constructs. The delve consists of circular Dwarven corridors connecting two main chambers, and breaking through into a natural cavern to the south. A Skyshard can be found in the large northernmost chamber. A Tattered Note can be found at a four-way intersection near the entrance to the natural caves. These caves contain the Construct's Left Hand, found laying on the ground near some gears; this is needed for the quest The Precursor. The unique Dwarven Sphere Zozuzetharus can be found in a shallow pool in the center of the natural cavern. During the quest A Mother's Obsession, Irenni Elendis can be found here, imprisoned by the bandits in their pantry. During the quest Long Lost Lore, a Forgotten Tome can be found here if your character is of the Pact.
